name: drop_job
description: Drop a building run that waits in the job queue (a real run started with wait: true) before it starts, so it never runs and nothing in the world changes. A later poll of its job_id answers status refused with error dropped. job_not_waiting when the job has started or ended; job_not_found when no job with that id is running, queued or kept.

job_id.description: The job_id the queued run answered, such as "upgrade-7".
